title: China’s Tmall Signals a New Era for K-Beauty: Growth Returns, but Polarization Deepens
summary: China’s K-beauty market may be showing signs of stabilization, but the latest sales data from Tmall suggests that the industry is entering a period of structural transformation rather than a broad-based recovery.An analysis of eight major K-beauty categories on Tmall during the third quarter of 2026

extraction.key_fact: 중국 티몰에서 케이뷰티는 시트 마스크와 베이스 메이크업 등의 전통 품목이 부진한 반면 기능성 스킨케어가 성장하며 양극화된 구조적 변화를 겪고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The result is an increasingly polarized market in which functional skincare is gaining momentum while legacy categories struggle to maintain relevance.
